name: CommonSpirit Health
verdict: Lost $687 million on operations, made $944 million anyway, and paid its CEO $14.2 million. For every dollar of free care, it takes in nearly ten dollars in subsidies and write-offs.

keyFigures.label: Hospital facilities
keyFigures.source: IRS Form 990 Schedule H Part V Section A, the 61 CommonSpirit hospital filers, FY2025: 144 hospital facility listings, 142 distinct hospitals after two listed on two returns (CHI Health St. Francis, Grand Island; St. Anthony Hospital, Pendleton). The two San Francisco hospitals sold to the University of California in August 2024 are left out.

keyFigures.label: Revenue, FY2025
keyFigures.source: CommonSpirit Health annual report for fiscal 2025, consolidated statements of operations (Ernst & Young LLP): total operating revenues $39,116 million

keyFigures.label: Net assets
keyFigures.source: CommonSpirit Health annual report for fiscal 2025, consolidated balance sheet: total net assets $23,573 million

keyFigures.label: CEO compensation
keyFigures.source: CommonSpirit Health Form 990 FY2025, Schedule J Part II: Wright Lassiter III, total compensation $14,175,319, of which $10,901,250 bonus and incentive

keyFigures.label: Long-term debt
keyFigures.source: CommonSpirit Health annual report for fiscal 2025, consolidated balance sheet: long-term debt, net of current portion, $17,154 million

money.asOf: As of June 30, 2025, from the audited statements and Form 990

items.text: in cash and investments on the balance sheet.
items.note: Cash $2.01B, short-term $0.26B, long-term $18.20B. FY2025 annual report, consolidated balance sheet (Ernst & Young).
items.source: CommonSpirit Health annual report for fiscal 2025, consolidated balance sheet: cash and cash equivalents $2,010M, short-term investments $255M, long-term investments $18,195M; total $20,460M

items.text: held in Cayman Islands insurance companies it controls.
items.note: First Initiatives Insurance Ltd, Grand Cayman: $1.89B in assets, $525M in income. Strategic and Physicians Insurance Ltd, Grand Cayman: $48.8M. Form 990 Schedule R, FY2025.
items.source: CommonSpirit Health Form 990 FY2025, Schedule R: Part I, First Initiatives Insurance Ltd (Grand Cayman, EIN 98-0203038, self-insurance), end-of-year assets $1,887,360,285 and total income $525,035,947; Part IV, Strategic and Physicians Insurance Ltd (Grand Cayman, EIN 98-1065338, captive insurance), share of end-of-year assets $48,810,524

items.text: sent abroad for investments in one year.
items.note: Caribbean $339.7M, Europe $91.1M. Form 990 Schedule F, CommonSpirit Health and Dignity Health, FY2025.
items.source: Form 990 FY2025, Schedule F Part I, activity type Investments: CommonSpirit Health, Central America and the Caribbean $326,467,516 and Europe $91,147,050; Dignity Health, Central America and the Caribbean $13,259,856; total $430,874,422

items.text: of free care its cash and investments could pay for at today's level.
items.note: $20.46B ÷ $616.2M of charity care a year (Schedule H 7a, all hospital filers).
items.source: Rojas Report calculation: cash and investments $20,460M (annual report) divided by charity care at cost, net, $616,247,940 (Schedule H Part I Line 7a column (e), summed over the 61 hospital filers, FY2025) = 33.2

freeCare.label: Free care actually delivered
freeCare.source: IRS Form 990 Schedule H Part I Line 7a column (e), financial assistance at cost, net, summed over CommonSpirit's 61 hospital filers, FY2025

costReportFreeCare.source: CMS Hospital Provider Cost Report (HCRIS), Worksheet S-10 cost of charity care, latest report per CCN for the 128 cost-report hospitals

ledger.caption: Fiscal year 2025, every line sourced

lines.name: The 340B program: drug discount spread (89 registrations, 811 contract pharmacy arrangements)
lines.source: HRSA 340B OPAIS covered entity export of September 29, 2026 (89 participating parent registrations, 306 child sites, 811 active contract pharmacy arrangements); spread estimate pending a method decision

lines.name: Graduate medical education: direct GME
lines.source: CMS Medicare cost report, Worksheet E-4; pending the HCRIS download

lines.name: Graduate medical education: indirect (IME)
lines.source: CMS Hospital Provider Cost Report (CostReport_2024_Final.csv, data.cms.gov), latest report per CCN, sum of Total IME Payment over the 128 cost-report hospitals: $122,958,063

lines.name: Medicare DSH adjustment
lines.source: CMS Hospital Provider Cost Report (CostReport_2024_Final.csv, data.cms.gov), latest report per CCN, sum of Disproportionate Share Adjustment over the 128 cost-report hospitals: $108,669,789

lines.name: Medicare uncompensated care payments (71 hospitals)
lines.source: CMS FY2027 IPPS correction notice, Medicare DSH supplemental data file, Total Uncompensated Care Payment summed over the 71 CommonSpirit hospitals projected to receive DSH in FY2027: $174,256,404

lines.name: Medicaid DSH
lines.source: State Medicaid DSH audit reports (medicaid.gov), 19 states; pending the download

lines.name: Medicare bad debt reimbursement
lines.source: CMS Medicare cost report, Worksheet E Part A, reimbursable bad debts; pending the HCRIS download

lines.name: Federal income tax exemption (21% of $931M audited excess)
lines.source: Rojas Report estimate: excess of revenues over expenses attributable to CommonSpirit Health $944M less the $13M gain on early extinguishment of debt (FY2025 audited statements) = $931M, at the 21% federal corporate rate

lines.name: Tax-exempt bond financing on $4.95B of bonds (interest savings)
lines.source: Form 990 FY2025 Part X Line 20, tax-exempt bond liabilities at year end: CommonSpirit Health $4,121.6M, Dignity Health $732.6M, Yavapai Community Hospital Association $94.0M; interest savings pending a sourced taxable-to-tax-exempt yield spread (MSRB EMMA)

lines.name: Property tax exemption ($14.8B of land and buildings; range $204.1M to $218.4M)
lines.source: Rojas Report estimate: land, land improvements and buildings at gross historical cost, $14,792,897,912 (CMS cost reports, latest per hospital), times each state's published rural commercial property tax rate (Lincoln Institute of Land Policy, 50-State Property Tax Comparison Study); low case $204,077,112, high case $218,425,834

lines.name: State income tax exemption (California rate; sales and use tax not estimated)
lines.source: Rojas Report estimate: the same $931M base at California's 8.84% corporation franchise tax rate (Cal. Rev. & Tax. Code section 23151), the headquarters-state rate without apportionment

lines.name: Charitable contribution deduction
lines.source: Form 990 Schedule B contribution totals, all filers; pending a donor tax-rate assumption

lines.name: Medicaid supplemental and state-directed payments
lines.source: CMS state-directed payment approvals and state supplemental payment (UPL) reports, 19 states; pending the download

lines.name: Provider tax: net gain after tax paid
lines.source: State hospital provider tax program reports (California Hospital Quality Assurance Fee first); pending the download

lines.name: Charity care, as claimed
lines.source: IRS Form 990 Schedule H Part I Line 7a column (e), financial assistance at cost, net, summed over the 61 hospital filers, FY2025: $616,247,940

lines.name: Medicaid shortfall claimed as community benefit
lines.source: IRS Form 990 Schedule H Part I Lines 7b and 7c column (e), unreimbursed Medicaid and other means-tested programs, net, summed over the 61 hospital filers, FY2025: $1,999,128,447

lines.name: Medicare shortfall touted as community benefit
lines.source: IRS Form 990 Schedule H Part III Line 7, Medicare surplus or shortfall, summed over the 61 hospital filers, FY2025: a shortfall of $1,065,404,951

lines.name: Bad debt written off
lines.source: IRS Form 990 Schedule H Part III Line 2, bad debt expense, summed over the 61 hospital filers, FY2025: $1,008,450,448

lines.name: Events, education, research, sponsorships and contributions
lines.source: IRS Form 990 Schedule H Part I Line 7k column (e), total community benefit $3,195,357,545, less Lines 7a to 7c ($616,247,940 and $1,999,128,447), summed over the 61 hospital filers, FY2025: $579,981,158

ledger.note: “est.” marks a figure calculated by The Rojas Report; the method is on the methodology page. A dash marks a line still being built from source filings.

fairShareNote: Free care is financial assistance at cost, net, as CommonSpirit's own hospital filers report it (Schedule H Line 7a, FY2025). The system's Medicare cost reports put it higher, at $864.9M (Worksheet S-10); on that basis the ratio is {s10ratio}. The ratio only rises as the open ledger lines fill.

buy.text: The full dataset for CommonSpirit Health: every subsidy line by hospital and year, plus the source documents. And a board-ready brief you can hand to a lawmaker, an attorney general or your own partners.

sourcesLine: Sources: IRS Form 990 and Schedule H, CMS Medicare cost reports (HCRIS), HRSA 340B OPAIS, CMS DSH and GME data, MSRB EMMA bond disclosures, county assessor records, state Medicaid filings.
